definitions.explanation: Something or someone that comes after or follows behind another. Often used for vehicles, people in a sequence, or products/works that follow an initial one.

examples.japanese: {後続|こうぞく}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To watch out for the car behind.

examples.japanese: {後続|こうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The following runners crossed the finish line one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|おお}ヒット⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{後続|こうぞく}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: This product was a big hit, but development of the follow-up model is behind schedule.

notes:
FORMATION: {後|こう} (after, behind) + {続|ぞく} (continue, follow).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後続|こうぞく}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: following vehicle, car behind
- {後続|こうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: the next/following train
- {後続|こうぞく}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧: follow-up model
- {後続|こうぞく}⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧: follow-up troops, reinforcements

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後続|こうぞく}: following, coming after (formal)
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: next (everyday term)
- ⟦{後任|こうにん}→後任：12580_kounin⟧: successor (for a person in a position)
